popupExpandToggleTip: Instead of taking the inner scrollable panels and iframes the way they appear, it enlarges them so as to cover all of their content. Frames coming from a different site ask for an extra permission one time.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and are synchronised with your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission given — frames coming from other sites are being expanded too.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames coming from a different site are captured the way they appear. Panels and iframes belonging to the same site work in every case.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Scans the text the page reveals for e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, credit card numbers, identity numbers and API keys and draws a solid block over the one that matched, in the saved image. It cannot read text drawn as pixels — a canvas, a visual, a PDF, a video frame. The detection runs on your device; nothing at all is sent anywhere. It works on full-page (document scrolling) captures; the block is permanent, so review the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF plays everywhere. WebM is smaller and more fluid (it is recorded live in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: For these pages to be opened, a one-off permission is needed at the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open these pages was refused.
